t: This is the Camden Chinese Community Centre, an organisation serving the local Chinese community in Camden. It was founded by Shu Pao Lim, born in 1923, a social worker. That origin matters: the centre grew from social work, from the practical business of supporting people in a community, rather than from a grand institutional plan. I don't have further detail on its history or activities, so I'll keep it short. It remains a local base for Camden's Chinese residents.
